I saved a draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in your DM. The draft hasn't been sent; someone still needs to send it from drafts.

- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** The proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 a seat, as Marcus Lindqvist gave it. It also says Anselm approved sharing it.

Under the rules, a per-seat rate normally goes only to Anselm, June or the account owner. Anselm is the CFO, so his approval here covers sending it to Hollis. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so the mail is internal and doesn't need Ruth Calloway's approval.

I used the $2,101 figure exactly as you wrote it. I didn't check it against Marcus's original message or any Thornbury files, because I didn't look outside what you can see.
